description: You are a Commissioning Agent responsible for onboarding a newly acquired commercial office building into the company's facility management system. Using OpenMaint (login: admin/admin at http://localhost:8090/cmdbuild/ui/), enter the complete building data from the commissioning report at /home/ga/Desktop/commissioning_report.txt. You must create: (1) A new Building record with Code 'BLD-WESTPARK', Description 'Westpark Office Tower', and address '2750 Westpark Drive, Houston, TX 77042'; (2) Four Floor records linked to this building: Ground Floor (Code: FLR-WP-G), Floor 1 (FLR-WP-1), Floor 2 (FLR-WP-2), and Floor 3 (FLR-WP-3); (3) Twelve Room records distributed across the floors as specified in the commissioning report — each room must have the correct Code, Description, and be linked to the correct floor; (4) Six infrastructure asset/equipment records representing key building systems (HVAC units, electrical panels, elevator, fire panel, generator, water heater) — each must be linked to the correct building and have the serial number from the report. Do NOT modify or delete any existing buildings, floors, rooms, or assets already in the system.
